arguments.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: final industrial-design presentation board, exactly one coherent image containing multiple views of one and the same resolved product
Primary request: Create a polished, credible industrial-design render of a compact Raspberry Pi 5 music workstation enclosure named only by a tiny neutral mark “SHR” if any mark is shown. The product is a low wedge console: approximately 190 mm wide, 165 mm deep, 96 mm high at the rear and 36 mm high at the front. Its 7-inch landscape touchscreen is recessed into the sloping top, screen plane about 22 degrees above horizontal, rising toward the rear so it faces the seated operator. The display remains in its native landscape orientation. The enclosure has a continuous grille-like front intake below the screen, a tall rear leveling heel that reaches the desk, and a rear exhaust grille with one visible 40 mm square fan behind it. The operator-right side has a recessed, clearly manufacturable connector pocket showing one RJ45 Ethernet opening and four stacked USB-A openings corresponding to a Raspberry Pi 5 port bank; do not add other side ports. The raised rear cable/service bay contains a recessed USB-C power inlet and two small HDMI-sized service/cable openings, plus a separate tidy cable gutter for the display’s internal connectors; show only plausible recessed openings, not loose impossible connectors. Include eight small unlabelled low-profile square control keys, four along each side rail of the screen, leaving the front intake unobstructed. Include a small round power button and one tiny amber status LED on the right rail. Rear feet and front feet should make the product sit level on a desk even though the main body is tilted.
Scene/backdrop: warm neutral design-studio background, product on a light grey tabletop
Style/medium: high-end realistic 3D CAD product visualization, manufacturable low-volume product, restrained modern digital mixing-console character with a subtle vintage analog-console stance, no decorative pastiche
Composition/framing: one 16:9 presentation image. Large hero three-quarter front-right view occupies about two thirds of the canvas and clearly shows the tilted screen, full front intake, right-side connector pocket, and wedge stance. Two smaller clean inset views on the left or upper rear: a rear three-quarter view showing the rear leveling heel, 40 mm exhaust grille and cable recess; and a low side-profile view showing the level feet and screen angle. All views depict exactly the same product, same colors and geometry. No alternate concepts.
Lighting/mood: soft studio key light with controlled reflections, clear edges, engineering credibility
Color palette: matte charcoal textured shell, black anodized screen bezel and front/rear perforated grilles, narrow dark-bronze anodized aluminum side rails, amber status LED; screen UI dark with a compact terminal-like music tracker grid in muted cyan and amber, no legible labels
Materials/textures: 2.5 mm molded/SLS polymer outer shell, 1.5 mm bent aluminum lower chassis suggested at edges, fine circular perforations in front and rear grilles, realistic silicone feet, restrained visible M2.5/M3 fasteners
Constraints: Single image file and single final design. Front intake must be visually open and grille-like. Rear heel must visibly extend to the tabletop. Rear fan must exhaust out the rear. Keep display landscape and connector edge toward raised rear. Connector openings must be recessed and geometrically credible. Show four USB-A and one Ethernet opening only in the right-side pocket. Maintain consistent geometry across all views. No arrows, no dimension text, no exploded view, no cutaway, no unsupported labels, no exposed circuit boards, no knobs, no faders, no speakers, no handles, no wood, no extra fans.
Avoid: science-fiction styling, oversized vents, impossible port geometry, random USB-C ports on the side, decorative fake meters, branding clutter, watermark, alternate colorways, floating cables, fingerprints, people, hands.
